exposure: Number of attempts at spinal anesthesia
cohort: 384 patients who underwent cesarean section under spinal anesthesia at the University of Gondar Comprehensive Specialized Hospital from March 01 to May 29, 2019
finding: Non-obese patients, larger spinal needles, multiple attempts at spinal anesthesia, and the educational status of anesthetists were independently associated with the risk of post-dural puncture headache.
